ENGINEERING CHECK, 14 Nov 2026 (verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-4066593, the merge of #53 = frozen commit 40665932; debug APK build 152 from the same commit; NOT the release-candidate pair; nothing is marked walked). THE WALK AFTER THE PC RESTART, SUMMARY. Frozen commit 40665932 (the merge of #53; the three docs PRs after it published no image). App CI green on it (verify + android-debug-build). Debug APK build 152 archived by commit; installed on the emulator only (the owner's phone was not touched). VM 108 updated to sha-4066593 and verified by the container's image label (the installer's "up to date" line is its usual message even when the image changed); migrations 12 and 13 applied.
PASS (engineering checks, notes on each item): N-15, P1-16, B-41 (note on P3-29), N-12, N-20, N-21, N-22, N-23a, N-24, N-25, P1-10, N-11 (unchanged), P2-28 and the B-58 slice (partial, see its note). N-13 PASSES FOR A PHONE WITH NO ROW FOR THE SONG and has a gap for the phone that tapped it (B-128). N-19 stays open.
NEW FINDINGS (audit rows): B-126 (Search makes a server song row for the Top result of every typing pause: junk rows, NOT YouTube look-ups; LOW), B-127 (the artist-picture pass is skipped for an hour when the cover finder's scan is still running; LOW), B-128 (N-13's grey is missing on the phone that tapped; MEDIUM for the feature), B-129 (`docker stop` of the Encore container ends with exit 137: not investigated; LOW). New board item N-26 for B-125 (channels saved as artists), placed in Now after N-25.
YOUTUBE: one tap on the unfindable song (up to 3 requests) in this run, on top of the 4 of the morning: at most 7 of 10. Typing queries letter by letter makes junk rows (B-126), not look-ups; from then on queries were typed in one call.
NOTHING WAS MARKED WALKED. The release-candidate pair (the published image installed by the guide on a clean machine plus the same-commit APK) still needs the owner's help: VM 108's clean snapshot lacks the pull credential for the private image (pink).
NEXT: P1-17 to a helper (plan first), then B-128 (N-13 on library rows), B-121 (needs a drawing), N-14's fix, N-16/P2-25, B-125 (N-26).
